title: grindmn crank arm (part 5) - machining
_comment: Outline is drawn as a fine polygon, so its round ends are not single edges: length and thickness are measured in the section, widths and end radii are in the notes.
notes: 6061-T6 plate 6.0, waterjet or milled, clear anodise. Flat 0.05. Width 14 at the hub end tapering to 12 at the knob end; ends full radius R7 (centre 2 mm beyond the hub axis) and R6 (on the knob hole).
Hub axis midway between the two M3 clearance holes (dia 3.4); knob hole 85.0 from the hub axis (crank radius).
Knob hole M4x0.7 tapped through for the ISO 7379 shoulder screw.
General tolerance ISO 2768-mK, linear +-0.1, angles +-0.5 deg; all edges 0.3x45; Ra 1.6 on fits, 3.2 elsewhere.
